title: Day 10 Broncos Training Camp Report: Payton Preparing for Preseason | Orange & Blue Today
text: Day 10 brought full‑speed, full‑pad energy to Broncos training camp, and Sean Payton clearly used Monday to prep his team for preseason tempo. The result: a crisp, competitive practice with standout performances on both sides of the ball — and a few players continuing their summer surge. Pat Bryant looked good again, stacking plays and proving he’s not just the WR3 — he’s one of the most consistent performers on the entire offense. His daily reliability is becoming a core part of this passing game. Rookie RB Jonah Coleman ripped off another big play, showing the burst and finishing power that keeps earning him more reps. Pads on, physical practice, and he still pops. Jaleel McLaughlin is turning heads too — sudden, slippery, and explosive. Every day he reminds the staff he deserves touches. On defense, Que Robinson created tons of pressure. His speed off the edge is becoming a real problem for tackles, and he’s stacking disruptive reps like a player pushing for a major role. And a notable development: the 2nd‑ and 3rd‑team offense looked better. Cleaner execution, better rhythm, and more confidence — exactly what Payton wants as preseason approaches. 🔥 In this episode: Pat Bryant continues his camp breakout Jonah Coleman delivers another explosive play Jaleel McLaughlin keeps turning heads Que Robinson generates relentless pressure 2nd & 3rd‑team offense showing real improvement Payton sharpening the team for preseason action Drop your Broncos take — which young playmaker is rising fastest, and who’s earning real snaps once preseason kicks off.

title: [FULL EPISODE] Coby Bryant to miss most of the season after having knee surgery
channel_name: Take The North: A Chicago Bears Podcast
text: Bears head coach Ben Johnson had a bombshell for us, as he told reporters that safety Coby Bryant is going to miss 4 to 6 months with his knee injury.
